criteria.name: GO001
criteria.description:
从GSA原始网页定位真实费率或M&IE文件引用，且说明其在预算中的用途。
Inspect output/conference_budget.xlsx, output/approval_brief.docx, output/approval_register.csv.

criteria.name: GO002
criteria.description:
三城市逐日按县、季节、FY2025/FY2026正确匹配费率，提供两年原表行号。
Inspect output/conference_budget.xlsx, output/approval_brief.docx, output/approval_register.csv.

criteria.name: GO003
criteria.description:
住宿按实际报价而非上限计费，四晚正确，12%税另计且不突破可报销基础。
Inspect output/conference_budget.xlsx, output/approval_brief.docx, output/approval_register.csv.

criteria.name: GO004
criteria.description:
首末日M&IE先按75%计算再扣整份政府供餐金额，保留杂费下限；其他日供餐扣减正确。
Inspect output/conference_budget.xlsx, output/approval_brief.docx, output/approval_register.csv.

criteria.name: GO005
criteria.description:
酒店免费早餐及茶歇不误扣；政府供餐日期和餐别全部使用。
Inspect output/conference_budget.xlsx, output/approval_brief.docx, output/approval_register.csv.

criteria.name: GO006
criteria.description:
六方案人数、机票、当地交通、注册和固定场地费不重复/遗漏，基础总额准确到分。
Inspect output/conference_budget.xlsx, output/approval_brief.docx, output/approval_register.csv.

criteria.name: GO007
criteria.description:
5%储备与53000预算正确比较，原六方案按总额的基础对照排序正确；最终批准同时遵守追加年度资金约束。
Inspect output/conference_budget.xlsx, output/approval_brief.docx, output/approval_register.csv.

criteria.name: GO008
criteria.description:
机票加20%的六方案压力预算和可执行超限措施正确。
Inspect output/conference_budget.xlsx, output/approval_brief.docx, output/approval_register.csv.

criteria.name: GO009
criteria.description:
解释跨财政年度版本选择及本次实际费率是否变化，不凭版本变化推定涨价。
Inspect output/conference_budget.xlsx, output/approval_brief.docx, output/approval_register.csv.

criteria.name: GO010
criteria.description:
审批登记覆盖授权、住宿安全、采购和资金确认，含角色、证据、期限和阻断状态，不假称已审批。
Inspect output/conference_budget.xlsx, output/approval_brief.docx, output/approval_register.csv.

criteria.name: GO011
criteria.description:
三份精确命名交付均可读，工作簿含Daily/Options/Sources，金额单位、来源和假设清楚。
Inspect output/conference_budget.xlsx, output/approval_brief.docx, output/approval_register.csv.

criteria.name: GO012
criteria.description:
批准简报与工作簿/CSV的推荐、关键金额和条件一致，内部建议与FTR义务明确区分。
Inspect output/conference_budget.xlsx, output/approval_brief.docx, output/approval_register.csv.

criteria.name: GO013
criteria.description:
FundingBridge逐一覆盖六方案及机票+20%情景，按decision_constraints.json的内部归集规则准确算出FY2025/2026基础额和各自5%储备，且两年合计与总额一致；归集约定不冒充联邦拨款法。
Inspect output/conference_budget.xlsx, output/approval_brief.docx, output/approval_register.csv.

criteria.name: GO014
criteria.description:
准确区分原年度额度41000/12000下可行性与尚待批准的FY2026转FY2025最多1500调整，给出最小调整及无解证明；分别按先人数后成本选无调整/调整获批的最优方案，压力情景不复用原储备额。
Inspect output/conference_budget.xlsx, output/approval_brief.docx, output/approval_register.csv.

criteria.name: GO015
criteria.description:
逐条复核GO-D1/GO-D2并将证据和决策影响写入DecisionAudit；最终批准简报和CSV登记与FundingBridge的年度缺口、调整审批和压力措施一致，不能将待批调整写成已获批资金。
Inspect output/conference_budget.xlsx, output/approval_brief.docx, output/approval_register.csv.
